annotations.text:
Five screens your backend already supports but the admin mockup did not show.

Every field here maps to a real column or service method — no invented data.

Courier panel drives CourierDispatcher: push(), syncStatus(), ineligibleReason().
States shown: not sent / dispatched / failed with last_error.
The SKU field is the gap that breaks the storefront today: the gallery prints 'Code: PV-401' but Add Product had nowhere to set it.
